profile.headline: SWE at Google and former Assistant Professor at University of Colorado Boulder
profile.summary: Eric’s interests are broadly defined in the areas of systems and networking, but he has specific interests in network management, datacenter networking, software-defined networking, wireless networking, and mobile computing. He has published more than 20 technical documents in esteemed international conferences, workshops, and journals. He has also filed more than 65 patents and regularly serves on technical program committees. Eric obtained his BS from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and his PhD from the University of Texas at Austin in 2011. He has worked as a senior member of the technical research staff at AT&T Labs Research and as a master inventor at IBM Research.

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description:
Focus: network management; cloud, mobile, edge, and serverless computing

Instruction: cloud technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, etc)

Advised five PhD students, 18 Masters students, and one undergraduate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Networking subject matter expert in the Remote Presence team. My role designs, builds, and evaluates new techniques for Real-time Video Streaming across Facebook's product suite.

positions.title: Research Staff Member; Master Inventor
positions.description:
Defined and lead projects in datacenter network management

Data-plane network monitoring technique improved state-of-art by 18-fold

End-host multi-path algorithm achieved near-optimal load balancing

Virtualized congestion control scheme overcame inefficient tenant TCP stacks

Mitigated noisy-neighbor problem in container-based deployments

Developed techniques for consistent routing updates and network tracing

Named Master Inventor for Intellectual Property contributions

positions.title: Senior Member of the Technical Staff - Research
positions.description:
Developed a rapid channel-sounding system on software-defined radios to quickly and cheaply determine coverage areas of LTE small cell access nodes

Patented technique to improve network management via cellular virtualization

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Mentor: Ranveer Chandra. Investigated potential of 802.11n technologies for real-time, high-definition video streaming. Performed detailed study of loss under high-performance wireless links in a living room environment. Profiled next-generation 802.11n vendor so- lutions and modified wireless drivers to obtain insights on characteristics of wireless loss. Work completed over the summer laid the foundation for the wireless controller protocol design for the Xbox One.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Mentors: Vishnu Navda, Ramachandran Ramjee. Developed and implemented network-based scheduling algorithms to realize power savings for mobile devices in Wi-Fi networks. Work published in MobiSys and featured in front page article on CNN.com.
